initialization: zero residual output, exact native forward at initialization
requirements: Read actual local projection shapes and report parameter counts; estimates are not verification.
Keep attention output gates unchanged when adapting q_proj.
Adapt GDN gates before sigmoid/softplus so their ranges remain valid.
All backbone parameters remain frozen; save only controller weights.
No cross-time feedback or KV cache enlargement.
Verify zero-init identity, finite nonzero adapter gradients, and frozen-backbone gradients before training.
Use disjoint train/validation/test seeds and entity namespaces; do not train on pilot or confirmation cases.
Match optimized tokens and steps across modes; compare preservation and initial-version questions as well as target answers.
Parameter sharing alone is not evidence of a semantic interface or a new architecture.
selection_note: Group 3 is a provisional mid/late starting point from the four-case overwrite transplant screen, not a demonstrated optimal location for COPY.

post_capacity_decision.fixed_schedule: Finish both registered arms at 64/256/1024 and audit complete four-value families; do not tune on original tests or the 70000-series benchmark.
post_capacity_decision.negative_interpretation: No family recovery is a failed carrier/readout assay, not evidence that recurrent information is absent or semantic writes destroyed it. Do not escalate this generic capacity/budget probe again by default.
post_capacity_decision.return_to_mainline: Use value-paired multi-entity COPY/SET/version tasks with full historical access and controlled independent/dependent updates; separate task truth, input/position identity and functional preservation. Compare shared vs independent vs ordinary local adaptation at the same data/budget.
post_capacity_decision.architecture_gate: Require a reproducible shared-interface gain over independent/local controls and preserved historical/ordered readouts before adding evidence bypass or cross-time feedback.
post_capacity_decision.scope: Single-fact readout is a diagnostic, not a replacement for semantic hybrid-block co-design.

post_semantic_acceptance_requirements: Compare all four fixed-budget arms on full-history value-paired semantic readouts and matched errors; same accuracy is not functional equivalence.
Report ADD separately and require correct before/control/treatment for preservation rather than merely fewer regressions.
Before an architecture claim, rule out fixed initial-record positions and fixed query templates, and confirm on fresh event families/initializations.
Do not label functional regressions as GDN state damage without path-specific interventions and suitable controls.
next_design: Complete GDN-only/Attention-only parameter-scope controls at the same augmented-data budget, then the registered native recurrent/convolution-versus-KV cache-source diagnostic. Neither has started model work.
